source.citation: G.~H. Hardy, J.~E. Littlewood and G.~P\'olya, \emph{Inequalities}, 2nd ed., Cambridge University Press, 1952., Theorem 1

proposals.title: Schur's inequality (exponent 1)
proposals.content: For all real numbers $a, b, c \ge 0$, $a(a-b)(a-c) + b(b-a)(b-c) + c(c-a)(c-b) \ge 0$.
proposals.new_module_overview: Classical polynomial inequalities for nonnegative reals.
